meta.summary: AI spend envelopes set at 0.5x sector median, calibrated for an experimenting manufacturing company with loose controls and approval gates on fine-tunes and new providers.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are reimbursable up to $50/month per employee only if no approved equivalent exists on the allowlist and the employee submits a vendor justification within 30 days of purchase.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn exceeds 90% before month end or single-hour spend exceeds 2x hourly run rate
Team envelope burn exceeds 110% of monthly allocation or unattributed spend exceeds $500 in 24 hours
Company envelope burn exceeds 100% before month end or agent kill threshold breached and loop not terminated

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $2,500 Support envelope and is correctly classified as COGS under the production environment rule; no action required.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38 falls well within the $4,500 Data envelope and is routine OpEx; logged and passed.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request spiked 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 60% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely a prompt-length regression or model routing misconfiguration introduced in the deploy.
rationales.e4: Subscription 3 for Marketing against a 5 subscription threshold. Approved.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 15000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: The research agent reached 340 calls per hour, exceeding the 50-retry-per-task limit, and its $47/hr burn rate with growing context would have consumed an estimated $1,090 before natural termination; the loop is blocked and the task is queued for manual restart.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is self-serve eligible under the 168-hour window with a delta cap of $1,200; the request is approved provided incremental cost stays within that cap.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key is running at 22x baseline with no project tag; ladder step 2 throttle applied by Engineering lead within 24 hours until the spend is attributed to a valid team envelope.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent purchased a $499 dataset license, which is within the $750 single-transaction ceiling and falls under the dataset-license merchant scope on the agent card; transaction approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month overlaps with the Sales team tool at $1,400/year running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to allow_with_review. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged internal-tool was submitted as COGS; the classification rule for project_tag internal-tool overrides to OpEx and the transaction is reclassified.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
